# Core/Utils

<!-- agent-docs:start (generated by eacp-agent-docs; edits here are overwritten) -->

## Headers

- [Base64.h](Base64.h): RFC 4648 §4, padded. (declares `encode`, `decode`)
- [Broadcaster.h](Broadcaster.h): declares `Broadcaster`, `Listener`
- [Common.h](Common.h): declares `Callback`
- [Console.h](Console.h): Writes `line` and a newline to stdout and flushes, so the output interleaves correctly with a child process's or a pipe reader's. (declares `print`, `printError`)
- [Containers.h](Containers.h): declares `Array`, `makeOwned`, `OwnedVector`, `OwningPointer`, `Span`, `Vector`
- [Environment.h](Environment.h): Reads an environment variable, or nullopt when it is unset. (declares `getEnv`, `getEnvValue`, `setEnv`, `unsetEnv`)
- [File.h](File.h): RAII handle for reading a file off disk in bounded chunks, without loading the whole thing into memory. (declares `File`)
- [FilePath.h](FilePath.h): A filesystem path carried as UTF-8 text, so public headers never need <filesystem>. (declares `FilePath`)
- [FileWatcher.h](FileWatcher.h): declares `FileWatcherOptions`, `FileWatcher`
- [FileWriter.h](FileWriter.h): RAII handle for writing a file in pieces: streaming, appending, or patching bytes at recorded offsets. (declares `FileWriter`)
- [Files.h](Files.h): declares `readFile`, `writeFile`, `writeFileAtomically`, `createDirectories`, `removeAll`, `exists`, `isFile`, `isDirectory`, `isSameFile`, `setExecutable`, `readSymlink`, `copyFile`, `copyDirectory`, `moveFile`, `removeFile`, `appendFile`, `writeFileAt`, `legalFileName`, `nonexistentSibling`, `nonexistentChild`, `matchesWildcard`, `EntryKind`, `DirectoryEntry`, `TraversalError`, `Visit`, `Symlinks`, `VisitingFunc`, `TraversalErrorFunc`, `DirectoryOptions`, `forEachEntry`, `listDirectory`, `listFiles`, `openWithSystem`, `revealInFileManager`, `revealFallbackDirectory`, `executablePath`, `applicationPath`, `enclosingBundle`, `resourcesDirectory`, `getBundleResourcePath`, `filenameFromPath`
- [Format.h](Format.h): float stays apart from double so "{}" prints the float's own shortest round-trip ("0.1"), not the widened double's. (declares `FormatArg`, `toFormatArg`, `vformat`, `format`, `shortestRoundTrip`)
- [Hash.h](Hash.h): The standard 64-bit FNV-1a: stable across platforms, builds and runs, so it can name something a build wrote and a later run looks up. (declares `fnv1a64`)
- [Logging.h](Logging.h): Writes a timestamped line to stdout (and, on Windows, to OutputDebugString so it shows up in the debugger when stdout isn't captured). (declares `logMessage`, `LOG`, `LOGF`, `setLogFile`, `getLogFile`)
- [MemoryMappedFile.h](MemoryMappedFile.h): A read-only view of a file's bytes, placed in the address space rather than copied into it: no allocation, no read, and pages arrive from the page cache as they are touched. (declares `MemoryMappedFile`)
- [Pimpl.h](Pimpl.h): declares `Pimpl`
- [Random.h](Random.h): declares `Random`
- [Range.h](Range.h): declares `Range`
- [Sha256.h](Sha256.h): declares `Sha256Digest`, `Sha256`, `computeSha256Hex`, `computeFileSha256`, `computeFileSha256Hex`
- [Singleton.h](Singleton.h): declares `get`, `getImmortal`
- [SourceWatcher.h](SourceWatcher.h): A FileWatcher over a source tree: every file under the directory matching the pattern, recursively, outside watcher.excludedDirectories. (declares `SourceWatcher`)
- [StdPath.h](StdPath.h): declares `toStdPath`
- [Strings.h](Strings.h): Strips leading and trailing spaces, tabs, CRs and LFs. (declares `trim`, `lastNonEmptyLine`, `lineContaining`, `toLower`, `toUpper`, `capitalize`, `uncapitalize`, `equalsCaseInsensitive`, `join`, `hexCharToInt`, `parseHex`, `toHex`, `formatHex`, `widen`, `narrow`, `toString`, `concat`, `tryParse`, `tryParseBool`, `parseOr`, `tryParseFloat`, `tryParseInt`, `parseFloatOr`, `parseIntOr`)
- [TemporaryFile.h](TemporaryFile.h): A unique path that is deleted, file or directory, when this goes out of scope. (declares `TemporaryFile`)
- [Time.h](Time.h): A duration in milliseconds. (declares `MS`, `sleep`, `sleepMS`, `sinceEpoch`, `formatIso8601`, `Deadline`)
- [WinInclude.h](WinInclude.h): declares `procAddress`
- [Zip.h](Zip.h): An archive or an entry can outgrow an int, so count one with getSize(). (declares `Bytes`, `Level`, `Entry`, `ExtractProgress`, `ExtractProgressFunc`, `Reader`, `Writer`, `compress`, `gzip`, `decompress`, `decompressText`)
